discovery_notes: WebFetch blocked (DNS failure on dlpreport.com); all evidence via search snippets. ~20 searches. Candidates evaluated: (1) Disney Classics London Pin Set - Disney Store UK, fixed 3-pin set (Pooh, Stitch, Peter Pan), Disney Pin Trading 2026 backstamp, official disneystore.co.uk listing with item no. 438030541031 -> CHOSEN: closed checklist, UK-exclusive, official retailer evidence, fully released (listed then sold out). (2) Disney Classics Collection Pinocchio LE 1000 2-pin set and Fantasia Sorcerer Mickey LE 1000 2-pin set (Disney Store UK, Feb/Mar 2026) - UK relevant but release/edition facts only found on excluded pinandpop; disneystore.eu category shows Pinocchio LE set at EUR 35 but no product page surfaced. Rejected for weak admissible evidence. (3) Magical Marksmen mystery blind pack (8 designs, $22.99, online July 2026 per WDWNT) - US, and resale listings suggest a 2025 parks origin, so 2026 status ambiguous. (4) Mickey Mouse & Friends 2026 Mystery Pin Blind Pack (8 designs, WDWNT) - US, released Dec 2025 so not strictly a 2026 release. (5) Pixar Animation Studios 40 Years Pin Sets 1-5 (DisneyStore.com, LE 700, $110, Jan-Feb 2026, Disney Pins Blog) - strong but US-only. Also checked: Disney Imaginative Icons Mystery (UK listing, but 2024 backstamp - not 2026); Disney Classics Film Posters sets/mystery (EU listing, year unconfirmed). Not to confuse: separate Mickey Mouse London Pin (438038210311, GBP 14, 2025 backstamp, Royal Guard) and Winnie the Pooh Royal Pin (GBP 16) are NOT part of this set. Conflict: set price GBP 20.00 vs GBP 25.00 in two search captures of the same official page (possible price change). Stock status also varied across captures. Gaps: no admissible release date, edition type/size, per-pin names, per-pin visual forms or colours.
